name: dsh-theme-admech
description: Pure Forge-Cathedral tech-gothic theme for DSH. v0.7.18 prevents the modal dialog frame from breaking the composer stats/context popovers. v0.7.17 fixes the black embedded Usage/Top-up page on Windows by matching the drag attribute on the host's own <header> before native WebContentsView bounds are measured. v0.7.16 adds a standalone vector tech-priest reconstruction asset. v0.7.0: Windows 11 verification pass — DPI-aware hairlines for 125%/150% scaling, density-corrected filigree strokes, host-aligned scrollbar width, Windows caption-row awareness, Contrast Themes support, reduced-motion splash skip, throttled re-tagging, Palatino Linotype in SVG ornament lettering. v0.6.3 fixes native Platform WebContentsView layout; v0.6.2 adds account/Platform dialog click and splash guards; v0.6.1 fixes blank file-card icons and expanded reasoning-row icons; v0.6.0 redesigns changed-file/deliverable cards; v0.5.3 startup title 铸造圣殿; v0.5.2 deep-diving/process icons; v0.5.1 composer removeChild fix; v0.5.0 startup splash; v0.4.2 icon restoration. macOS + Windows verified. 机械神教 · 铸炉圣殿。
